title: HR Recruiter
description:
**Job Title: HR Executive — Human Resources \& Administration**  
**Company: Gulf To World Group LLP (Gulf To World Consultants)**  
**Location: Chhatarpur, New Delhi — 110074 (Full\-Time \| On\-Site)**  
**Salary: Competitive Fixed \+ Performance Benefits**

**About Gulf To World Group LLP**

Gulf To World Group LLP is a fast\-growing immigration consultancy operating from New Delhi, India and Doha, Qatar. We specialise in Europe Work Permits, Canada PR, Australia Skilled Migration, Portugal D2, and Investment Immigration. As we scale rapidly in 2026 — building our team, systems, and processes — we are looking for a capable and organised HR Executive to manage our people operations and support day\-to\-day administration.

**The Role**

We are looking for an HR Executive who is hands\-on, organised, and people\-oriented. This is a full\-spectrum HR role covering the complete employee lifecycle — from hiring and onboarding to payroll coordination, compliance, and exit — with additional responsibility for general office administration. You will be the go\-to person for everything related to people and office management at Gulf To World.

This is not a back\-office role. You will work closely with the Founder, Sales Manager, and senior leadership — your work directly impacts team performance, culture, and operational efficiency.

**HR Responsibilities**

**Recruitment \& Hiring**

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for all roles — post jobs on Indeed, Naukri, LinkedIn, and other platforms
* Screen applications, conduct initial telephonic interviews, and schedule candidates for management rounds
* Coordinate walk\-in drives and bulk hiring processes
* Maintain a talent pipeline for frequently hired roles — immigration consultants, telecallers, case managers
* Draft offer letters, appointment letters, and employment agreements

**Onboarding \& Induction**

* Conduct structured onboarding for all new joiners — company introduction, policy briefing, role clarity
* Ensure all joining documentation is complete — Aadhaar, PAN, bank details, emergency contact
* Coordinate with department heads for role\-specific induction and training schedules
* Set up new employee profiles in HR records and communication tools

**Attendance \& Leave Management**

* Maintain accurate daily attendance records for all employees
* Manage leave applications, approvals, and leave balance tracking
* Coordinate with reporting managers on attendance exceptions and regularisation
* Prepare monthly attendance summary for payroll processing

**Payroll Coordination**

* Compile monthly payroll inputs — attendance, leaves, variable pay, deductions, incentives
* Coordinate with the accounts team or payroll vendor for timely salary processing
* Maintain salary records, salary revision letters, and increment documentation
* Handle full and final settlement calculations for exiting employees

**Performance \& Disciplinary**

* Support managers in documenting performance improvement plans (PIPs)
* Draft warning letters, show cause notices, and disciplinary communications
* Maintain employee performance records and appraisal documentation
* Coordinate half\-yearly and annual appraisal cycles

**HR Policies \& Compliance**

* Maintain and update the HR policy manual — leave policy, attendance policy, code of conduct
* Ensure basic statutory compliance — PF, ESI, professional tax coordination with accounts
* Handle employee grievances professionally and confidentially
* Maintain all employee files — physical and digital — in organised and audit\-ready condition

**Employee Engagement \& Culture**

* Plan and coordinate team events, celebrations, and recognition activities
* Manage employee birthday and work anniversary acknowledgements
* Support a positive and productive workplace culture
* Coordinate with the team for internal communications and announcements

**Exit Management**

* Handle resignation processing — acknowledgement, notice period management, exit interviews
* Coordinate full and final settlement with accounts
* Issue experience letters, relieving letters, and NOC as required
* Maintain exit data and identify patterns in attrition

**Administration Responsibilities**

* Manage day\-to\-day office operations — stationery, supplies, housekeeping, vendor coordination
* Maintain office inventory — equipment, furniture, consumables — and coordinate replenishment
* Coordinate with building management for maintenance and facility issues
* Manage courier, postal, and document dispatch requirements
* Maintain filing systems for legal documents, agreements, and company records
* Support management in scheduling meetings, travel arrangements, and calendar management
* Coordinate with IT support for employee laptop, system, and connectivity requirements
* Handle petty cash for office expenses and maintain petty cash records
* Liaise with external vendors — printers, couriers, cleaning services, security — for smooth operations

**What We Are Looking For**

* Graduate in any discipline — MBA or Postgraduate in HR preferred but not mandatory
* 1 to 3 years of experience in an HR generalist or HR executive role
* Prior experience in a consultancy, services, or fast\-paced startup environment preferred
* Strong knowledge of core HR processes — hiring, onboarding, payroll inputs, compliance basics
* Excellent communication in Hindi and English — written and spoken
* Highly organised with strong attention to detail — you manage multiple things simultaneously
* Discreet and trustworthy — you will handle sensitive employee and company information
* Proficient in Microsoft Office — Excel, Word, and basic HR tools or HRMS
* Proactive and self\-driven — does not wait to be told what needs to be done

**What You Will Get**

* Competitive fixed salary based on experience
* Opportunity to build the entire HR function of a rapidly growing company
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and business operations
* Performance\-linked annual increment and bonus
* Festive bonuses and team incentives
* A young, energetic, and ambitious team environment
* Clear growth path — Senior HR Executive and HR Manager roles as G2W expands

**What Makes This Role Exciting**

G2W is not a large corporation with a rigid HR department. You will be joining at a growth stage — which means you are not just maintaining systems — you are building them. If you are someone who likes variety, ownership, and the feeling of making a visible difference every single day — this is your role.

**How to Apply**

title: Global Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
**About the Role**



Globalli is seeking an experienced Global Talent Acquisition Partner to join our People team and support hiring across our growing, multinational organization. This role will report to the HR Manager and partner closely with hiring managers across Technology, Go\-to\-Market, HR/Workforce Management, and corporate functions.



This is a hands\-on talent acquisition role for someone who is comfortable working across different functions, seniority levels, countries, and time zones. The ideal candidate understands how recruiting works in a multinational environment and can adapt sourcing and hiring practices to different talent markets while maintaining a consistent, high\-quality candidate experience.



You will manage the recruiting process from role intake and sourcing through interviews, offer coordination, and onboarding handoff, while keeping hiring managers informed and ensuring our ATS and recruiting data remain accurate and current.


**What You'll Do**



Global Talent Acquisition


* Manage full\-cycle recruiting for roles across Technology, Go\-to\-Market, HR/Workforce Management, and corporate functions.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs, define role requirements, establish interview processes, and develop realistic hiring timelines.
* Develop sourcing strategies based on the role, location, seniority, and local talent market.
* Source both active and passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, professional networks, referrals, and other sourcing channels.
* Conduct candidate screening and initial interviews, assess qualifications against established requirements, and provide clear candidate feedback to hiring managers.
* Coordinate interviews and maintain momentum throughout the hiring process.
* Manage offer processes in partnership with the HR Manager and hiring managers.
* Complete recruiting activities and provide a clear handoff to HR for onboarding and new hire setup.
* Maintain consistent communication with candidates throughout the process and help deliver a strong candidate experience.


Global \& Multinational Recruiting


* Recruit across multiple countries and regions, including North America, LATAM, EMEA, and APAC.
* Understand how recruiting practices, talent availability, compensation expectations, employment considerations, and time zones can differ by market.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines in both established and emerging hiring markets.
* Coordinate effectively with candidates and hiring managers across multiple time zones.
* Develop practical sourcing strategies that balance talent quality, location, and cost considerations.


Recruiting Operations \& Process


* Manage candidate activity and workflows in Greenhouse, ensuring accurate candidate records, stage movement, interview feedback, and data hygiene.
* Create and maintain job postings, candidate outreach, interview plans, and scorecards.
* Track recruiting activity and provide regular reporting on pipeline health, time\-to\-fill, offers, hiring activity, and sourcing effectiveness.
* Help identify opportunities to improve recruiting processes, candidate experience, and hiring manager effectiveness.
* Maintain organized recruiting documentation and ensure processes are followed consistently.
* Support recruiting projects and process improvements as the company and hiring needs evolve.


Employer Branding \& Talent Engagement


* Develop compelling candidate outreach and job postings that accurately represent Globalli and the opportunity.
* Help strengthen Globalli's presence in relevant talent markets and professional communities.
* Support employee referrals, social sourcing, and other initiatives that expand our talent pipeline.


**What You'll Bring**



Must\-Have Qualifications


* 3\+ years of full\-cycle talent acquisition/recruiting experience, preferably in a fast\-paced technology, SaaS, startup, or multinational environment.
* Demonstrated experience recruiting across multiple functions, such as Technology, GTM/Sales, HR/Operations, Finance, or other professional roles.
* Experience managing the recruiting lifecycle from intake through onboarding handoff.
* Experience recruiting across multiple countries or international talent markets.
* Strong sourcing experience, including hands\-on use of LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools.
* Experience working with an ATS, preferably Greenhouse, including candidate tracking, workflow management, reporting, and data hygiene.
* Strong candidate assessment, communication, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple open requisitions and competing priorities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Comfortable working directly with hiring managers and clarifying or challenging requirements when needed.
* Fluent English, written and spoken.
* Reliable internet and a professional home\-office environment.
* Ability to maintain meaningful working\-hour overlap with the New York/Eastern Time zone.


Preferred Qualifications


* Experience recruiting for a global technology, SaaS, fintech, HR\-tech, payroll, or workforce management company.
* Technical recruiting experience, including engineering, SRE/infrastructure, data, or cloud roles.
* Experience recruiting GTM roles, including Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, or Marketing.
* Experience recruiting HR, payroll, implementation, workforce management, or other operational roles.
* Experience recruiting across North America, LATAM, EMEA, and/or APAC.
* Spanish or another widely spoken business language.
* Experience recruiting in a remote\-first or distributed organization.
* Experience working with compensation benchmarks and adapting recruiting strategies to different geographic markets.
* Experience supporting employer branding, talent communities, or recruiting analytics.
